usage_snippets.text: 7 degrees Celsius [ 10 ]. To simulate chewing forces over approximately one year, cyclic compressive loads ranging from 15 to 30 N were applied on the palatal incline of the buccal cusp. This was achieved using a 2.5 mm steel ball at a cross-head speed of 0.5 mm/min. A total of 250,000 cycles were completed using a Universal Testing Machine (UTM) (Instron 9400, USA), simulating nearly one year of chewing [ 11 ]. Following the cyclic loading, a steel sphere with a width of 6 mm was used to apply compressive force on the buccal and palatal cusps, as well as the surface of the restoration of each test specimen.
